name: AUM Shreem Mahalakshmyai Namah
meaning: I offer salutations to Mahalakshmi, the presence of auspiciousness and abundance.
purpose: A short devotional invocation of Lakshmi.
supports: Gratitude; wise stewardship of resources; openness to opportunity; recognising sufficiency.
when: During a prosperity-focused meditation or Friday devotional practice.
note: Shreem is a bija syllable. Use as a simple devotional formula; advanced Lakshmi tantric practices may have additional instructions.
